documentUnderAssessment.publicScopeMetadata: Securing passenger cars and light commercial vehicles on vehicle transporters; official public catalogue metadata states applicability up to and including 4.5 t actual mass on transporters suitable and equipped for the standard.
documentUnderAssessment.licenseBoundary: No licensed normative text, tables, figures, calculations, procedures or derived reconstruction was acquired or used.

functionalImpact.function: Car Mover - vehicle driven on its own wheels
existingAlternativeAuthority: Road traffic, driver, vehicle, route and operational authorities applicable to the driven vehicle
functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Plan and execute movement of a drivable vehicle on its own wheels, subject to the ordinary vehicle, driver, route and jurisdiction checks.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: Do not attach cargo-securing or VDI 2700 Blatt 8.1 compliance claims to an own-wheels movement.
functionalImpact.requiredFallback: NOT_APPLICABLE for VDI 2700 Blatt 8.1; use ordinary Car Mover safety and legal checks.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: LOW, provided the mode cannot silently change to platform/transporter.

functionalImpact.function: Car Mover - passenger/light commercial vehicle on platform or trailer
existingAlternativeAuthority: Directive 2014/47/EU article 13 and Annex III within its scope
functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: State public legal duties, require an applicable load plan/calculation, verify documented mass/equipment/anchor data and require competent human approval.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: No exact VDI-specific arrangement, equipment sufficiency, securing count, loading pattern or VDI compliance verdict.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: MEDIUM if hard-stopped and human-verified; HIGH if the product presents prescriptive securing output.

functionalImpact.function: Autotransporter carrying passenger/light commercial vehicles within public Blatt 8.1 scope metadata
functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Identify the legal duty and the need for the current standard, load plan, transporter instructions and qualified verification.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: No transporter-specific normative securing solution, no standard-compliance audit and no release decision.
functionalImpact.requiredFallback: INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY for normative solution; refer to licensed current standard and a competent person.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: HIGH because the missing material is the vehicle-transporter-specific technical layer.

functionalImpact.function: Autotransporter carrying vehicles outside Blatt 8.1 public scope metadata
existingAlternativeAuthority: Applicable law and the separately applicable standard or manufacturer/load-plan evidence
functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: State that Blatt 8.1 applicability is not demonstrated and identify the need for the correct authority.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: Do not extrapolate Blatt 8.1 to vehicles above its public mass/scope metadata or to transporter configurations not demonstrated.
functionalImpact.requiredFallback: UNKNOWN plus HUMAN_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED; identify the separately applicable standard.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: HIGH if misclassified; LOW after correct scope routing.

existingAlternativeAuthority: UNECE CTU Code as non-mandatory guidance
functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Explain public duties, observable risks, general restraining method categories, missing-data checks and escalation.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: Do not label generic guidance as a substitute for the applicable calculation, standard, load plan or professional inspection.
functionalImpact.requiredFallback: PUBLIC_LEGAL_GUIDANCE, escalating to HUMAN_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED where technical sufficiency is asked.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: LOW to MEDIUM with advisory wording and a mandatory stop before operational release.

functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Ask whether cargo position, straps, labels, anchor points, load plan/calculation, axle distribution and competent approval were checked.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: Checklist completion must not equal legal or VDI compliance.
functionalImpact.requiredFallback: If required evidence is missing, BLOCKED/HUMAN_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED rather than READY.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: LOW if checklist is evidence collection, not a technical sufficiency algorithm.

existingAlternativeAuthority: licensed standard used by a competent human
functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Collect proof that the applicable plan and equipment were checked and record deviations or unknowns.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: Do not embed or infer the Blatt 8.1-specific normative checklist or convert visual completion into compliance.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: MEDIUM; becomes HIGH if the checklist contains prescriptive technical acceptance criteria.

functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Stop safely, protect persons, do not continue with displaced/uncertain cargo, document, notify and obtain competent reassessment.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: Do not issue a post-incident VDI compliance clearance or a transporter-specific re-securing recipe.
functionalImpact.requiredFallback: HUMAN_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED; follow competent authority and company instructions.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: LOW for escalation guidance; HIGH for a return-to-service decision.

functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Explain public rules, identify missing facts, surface visible risks and route technical questions to the standard or a competent person.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: No invented VDI rule, no binding legal advice, no automatic acceptance, no normative strap count or compliance statement.
functionalImpact.requiredFallback: Use explicit state vocabulary and refuse normative transporter-specific conclusions.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: MEDIUM due to user over-reliance; controlled by hard output boundaries and audit.

functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Warn about movement, falling, tipping, damaged/unknown equipment, unreadable labels, missing plan and need to stop/escalate.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: Warnings cannot claim that a specific configuration fails or passes Blatt 8.1 unless supported by licensed authority and verified facts.

functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Describe the legal duties and allocation of responsibilities, and state that recognized technical rules/current standards may be required.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: Do not describe private standard details as law or give a definitive case-specific legal conclusion.
functionalImpact.requiredFallback: PUBLIC_LEGAL_GUIDANCE with legal/professional review for case-specific conclusions.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: MEDIUM because compliance depends on facts, jurisdiction, contracts and current technical rules.

existingAlternativeAuthority: UNECE CTU Code where relevant and clearly non-mandatory
functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Teach public duties, risk recognition, evidence collection, mode separation and escalation.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: Do not reproduce, paraphrase as a substitute, or teach the normative Blatt 8.1 method as if licensed.
functionalImpact.requiredFallback: REFER_TO_STANDARD for standard-specific training; use licensed trainers/material where required.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: LOW for public/general content; HIGH for purported VDI training.

existingAlternativeAuthority: Public law can establish duties but does not supply the missing transporter-specific technical decision layer
functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Return evidence status, missing inputs and required authorities; support a human decision without deciding compliance.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: No VDI COMPLIANT, SAFE TO DEPART, PASS or equivalent transporter-specific compliance verdict.
functionalImpact.requiredFallback: INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY or LICENSED_STANDARD_REFERENCE_REQUIRED; final human verification.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: CRITICAL if automated; MEDIUM if reduced to an evidence-readiness gate.

existingAlternativeAuthority: external licensed-standard reference and human attestation
functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Preserve source metadata, evidence, unknowns, standard edition/corrigendum reference and who performed the competent check.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: An audit trail proves what was checked; it does not prove VDI compliance without authorized normative evaluation.
functionalImpact.requiredFallback: Record LICENSED_STANDARD_REFERENCE_REQUIRED and the external attestation, without storing unlicensed content.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: LOW for traceability; HIGH if the audit label implies normative certification.

functionalImpact.function: Recommendations about straps, anchoring points, blocking and fixing
existingAlternativeAuthority: Directive 2014/47/EU general principles and listed standards
functionalImpact.safeWithoutVdi: Identify visible condition, read user-confirmed labels, describe general categories and require the applicable calculation/plan.
functionalImpact.mustNotSayWithoutVdi: No exact count, pattern, capacity acceptance, angles, loading image or sufficiency conclusion derived from Blatt 8.1.
functionalImpact.residualRisk: MEDIUM under current non-normative guardrails; CRITICAL if prescriptive output is enabled.

ownWheels.reason: The subject vehicle is the driven road vehicle, not cargo on a vehicle transporter.
ownWheels.mandatoryControl: Mode must be explicit and immutable for the job; conversion to transport-on-platform requires reclassification and a new safety gate.

platformOrTransporter.reason: The vehicle becomes cargo and public VDI metadata identifies Blatt 8.1 specifically with passenger/light commercial vehicles on vehicle transporters.
platformOrTransporter.mandatoryControl: Do not assume applicability from the word platform alone; confirm cargo type/mass, transporter configuration, jurisdiction, applicable standard, load plan and competent approval.

authorityCoverage.requirement: German public-law duty to secure cargo and equipment against emergency braking/evasive movement and observe recognized technical rules
authorityCoverage.residualGap: Does not contain the vehicle-transporter-specific technical method.

authorityCoverage.requirement: Allocation of transport-safe loading/stowage/securing and operationally safe loading between sender and carrier
authorityCoverage.residualGap: Does not define technical sufficiency or a vehicle-specific securing solution.

authorityCoverage.requirement: EU roadside-inspection cargo-securing principles, force directions, axle distribution, component strength, method categories and standards references
authorityCoverage.existingAuthority: Directive 2014/47/EU article 13 and Annex III, current consolidated version shown by EUR-Lex as 2022-09-27
authorityCoverage.residualGap: Inspection framework, not a universal replacement for national law or Blatt 8.1 transporter-specific instructions.

authorityCoverage.requirement: Non-mandatory intermodal packing and securing good practice
authorityCoverage.residualGap: Non-mandatory and focused on cargo transport units; not a Blatt 8.1 substitute.
Does not replace general law or vehicle-transporter-specific technical rules outside ADR.

authorityCoverage.requirement: Official identity, edition, scope summary and corrigendum relationship for Blatt 8.1
authorityCoverage.residualGap: No normative instructions, values, diagrams, calculations or compliance basis.

authorityCoverage.requirement: Exact technical solution and a Blatt 8.1 compliance determination
authorityCoverage.existingAuthority: None available to AGM under the current license boundary
authorityCoverage.residualGap: Licensed current standard plus corrigendum and explicit usage/AI rights, or external competent verification, are required.

architectureOptions.description: AGM stores metadata, edition, corrigendum, official URI, applicability metadata and acquisition/access requirement only; normative evaluation occurs outside AGM by a licensed competent user.
architectureOptions.functionalFit: Supports reference, evidence routing and audit metadata, not technical answers.
architectureOptions.legalRisk: LOW if no content or derived normative output is stored and access is properly licensed externally.
architectureOptions.operationalRisk: MEDIUM due to workflow friction and dependence on human access.
architectureOptions.closureEffect: Can close the library architecture with an explicit external-standard boundary; cannot claim normative coverage 4/4.

architectureOptions.description: AGM answers only from reviewed public law and official public guidance; standard-specific questions are referred out.
architectureOptions.functionalFit: Sufficient for own-wheels Car Mover, legal-duty explanation, general warnings and evidence-readiness checks.
architectureOptions.operationalRisk: MEDIUM/HIGH for platform/transporter users who need a concrete technical solution.
architectureOptions.closureEffect: Architectural closure is possible only after formally excluding normative transporter compliance from AGM scope.

architectureOptions.description: AGM combines public legal rules, original non-normative safety checklists, visual observations, mandatory stop conditions and human confirmation, while refusing VDI compliance claims.
architectureOptions.functionalFit: Best fit for current product behavior and preserves useful load-safety assistance without licensed text.
architectureOptions.legalRisk: LOW/MEDIUM, controlled by output policy, provenance and explicit non-compliance wording.
architectureOptions.operationalRisk: LOW for own-wheels and advisory workflows; MEDIUM for transported-vehicle workflows because a qualified external decision remains necessary.
architectureOptions.closureEffect: Recommended basis for architectural closure with a declared licensed-standard capability boundary.

architectureOptions.description: Acquire both document access and explicit rights for the intended AI processing, storage, retrieval, derivative output, multi-user access and audit model.
architectureOptions.functionalFit: Could enable grounded standard-specific Q&A, controlled normative checklists, rule/edition comparison, cited technical decision support and stronger compliance audit, subject to expert validation.
architectureOptions.legalRisk: Depends on written license scope and implementation controls; purchase alone is not proof of AI rights.
architectureOptions.operationalRisk: Lower technical workflow friction but higher governance, freshness, rights-management and validation burden.
architectureOptions.closureEffect: Required only if those additional normative capabilities are an approved product requirement. No purchase is justified solely to close a numeric 4/4 metric.

allowedStates.PUBLIC_LEGAL_GUIDANCE: A reviewed public authority directly supports the statement within scope.
allowedStates.LICENSED_STANDARD_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: The question requires the current private technical standard or an authorized external evaluation.
allowedStates.HUMAN_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: A competent person must verify the facts, plan, calculation, equipment or applicability.
allowedStates.INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY: AGM lacks an authority capable of supporting the requested conclusion.
allowedStates.UNKNOWN: Applicability, currentness or a material fact cannot be demonstrated; UNKNOWN is not safe, zero, pass or compliant.

forbiddenOutputs: VDI COMPLIANT or equivalent without licensed authority, verified inputs and authorized evaluation
SAFE TO DEPART/PASS based only on a photo, checklist or public-law summary
Exact transporter-specific strap count, loading pattern, angles, capacities or acceptance limits attributed to Blatt 8.1
Secondary recommendations presented as if they were the licensed standard
Automatic carry-over of own-wheels logic to platform/transporter mode
UNKNOWN converted to ZERO, SAFE, PASS, NO RESTRICTION or UNCHANGED
mandatoryRuntimeRules: Transport mode must be explicit before load-safety advice is selected.
Normative recommended strap count remains null without an authorized calculation path.
Platform/transporter technical sufficiency requires an applicable plan/calculation and human approval.
Every answer identifies authority type: public law, contextual guidance, user evidence or licensed external reference.
Standard edition and corrigendum currentness must be checked before any external reliance.

riskAssessment.legalRiskSummary: The main legal risk is not absence itself but presenting public/general guidance as if it answered the recognized-technical-rules question for a concrete transporter configuration.
riskAssessment.operationalRiskSummary: A platform/transporter user still needs a current licensed standard/load plan and competent verification; AGM can safely manage evidence readiness and escalation but cannot release the load.

recommendation.reason: Current Car Mover is own-wheels and current Load Safety already suppresses normative counts and compliance certification. The full licensed text is not required for these bounded functions.
recommendation.purchaseTrigger: Purchase/enterprise licensing becomes justified only after Product Owner approves a concrete requirement for standard-specific transporter instructions, normative calculations/checklists, VDI compliance decision support, or auditable standard-based release decisions.
recommendation.closureRecommendation: LEGAL-003 may be closed architecturally without acquisition only by replacing the legacy 4/4 normative-content requirement with an explicit excluded capability: LICENSED_STANDARD_REFERENCE_REQUIRED. Preserve 3/4 under the legacy evidence metric; do not relabel missing licensed evidence as 4/4.
productOwnerDecisionRequired: Approve or reject the Hybrid Safety Model plus external licensed-standard reference boundary.
Approve or reject removal of in-product normative Blatt 8.1 compliance from current product scope.
If approved, close OWNER_LICENSED_ACQUISITION_REQUIRED as NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_APPROVED_SCOPE and retain LICENSED_STANDARD_REFERENCE_REQUIRED as a permanent capability limitation.
If normative transporter compliance remains required, keep LEGAL003-BLK-001 open and evaluate explicit enterprise/AI rights before purchase.
